records.description: The future of Linux is intelligent. LinuxOS-AI is a reimagined terminal powered by Gemini CLI. It’s your first glimpse into an AI-native operating system—where you speak commands and your OS acts with intent. Fully open-source. Just getting started.

records.name: Zubo
records.tagline: Self-reflection game
records.description: Discover your inner persona through 100 thought-provoking questions in this engaging self-reflection game.

records.name: SettleThis
records.tagline: Your AI Judge for life's little debates
records.description: Settle life's debates with instant AI verdicts! SettleThis lets you debate any topic with friends and get unbiased reasoning. Download now on iOS.

records.name: Wizyz
records.tagline: AI Business Website Builder
records.description: Wizyz is an AI website generator. It helps small businesses create a complete, professional website in seconds — simply by describing their business. Instead of using drag-and-drop builders or dealing with hosting and technical setup, users just type what their business does. Wizyz instantly generates a ready-to-use website that can be edited easily and published when ready.

records.name: ScreenshotMAX
records.tagline: The Screenshot API when reliability matters
records.description: Render websites or HTML to images and video with precision. The API blocks cookie banners and ads automatically, using the latest version of Google Chrome for rendering and Google Cloud Platform for fast, scalable performance.

records.name: AgentTip
records.tagline: Trigger AI agents in any macOS app with a keystroke
records.description: AgentTip lets you run OpenAI Assistants or local models (via Ollama) from any macOS app—just type a trigger like @idea, hit Return, and get the AI’s reply instantly, right in place. No windows, no context-switch, no copy-paste.

records.name: GetBotyfied
records.tagline: Chatbots without the code headache – GetBotyfied and relax!
records.description: GetBotyfied offers easy, no-code chatbot integration for beginners. Pay once ($40) for lifetime access to customizable bots. Add your OpenAI API key and integrate instantly.

records.name: FinanzerPro
records.tagline: Smart personal finance management
records.description: Take control of your finances with FinanzerPro. Track expenses, set budgets, achieve goals, and get AI-powered insights for better financial decisions. Scan bills, track expenses, hit goals, all in one clean dashboard.

records.name: OpenDia
records.tagline: no need to switch browsers, just use dia on chrome or arc
records.description: Connect your browser to AI models. No browser switching needed—works seamlessly with any Chromium browser, including Chrome & Arc.

records.name: Slide Thru
records.tagline: The YOLO, not Solo app
records.description: Life’s too short to do anything alone. Coffee run? Study session? Last-minute concert? Just post what you’re doing, when, and where — and let people nearby join in. No plan is too casual or too spontaneous.

records.name: iBrowsy
records.tagline: AI-powered macOS open source browser with Ai built in.
records.description: 🌐 A modern, AI-powered web browser for macOS built with SwiftUI. Features intelligent browsing assistant, advanced privacy protection, picture-in-picture, youtube native ad's blocker, and productivity tools. Open source and privacy-first. - TicClik/iBrowsy

records.name: AI Gallery
records.tagline: The unlimited AI image generator you've been waiting for
records.description: Transform your ideas into pro-level artwork with AI Gallery! 🎨 Access 50+ models (SDXL, AlbedoBase XL, Juggernaut XL, Nova Anime XL, and more) to generate incredible images in seconds. 💰 Completely Free & Unlimited: No watermarks, no sign-ups, no catch.

records.name: ArchivlyX
records.tagline: Organize, search & download your twitter archive
records.description: Take control of your Twitter data — the all-in-one tool to organize, search, and download your bookmarks, likes, and more. Fast, secure, and 100% private.

records.name: Instant Compliance Insights
records.tagline: Instantly discover your compliance landscape
records.description: Drop your company info and get a custom list of compliance frameworks you should care about. Built for startups, trusted by advisors and not limited to software companies!

records.name: Hustler toolkit pro
records.tagline: Cashflow Tools Pack: Build Income Daily
records.description: Launch your online income machine. Access growth scripts, offer builders & hustle blueprints to turn ideas into real cashflow—automated & daily.

records.name: CitySage
records.tagline: Social Media AI Travel Planner
records.description: CitySage lets you plan, publish, and explore travel routes — solo or socially. Use AI or build manually, add stops, images, and maps, then share with followers or remix others’ tours. Travel planning meets storytelling.

records.name: Humanify
records.tagline: Turn Your Selfie Into AI “Talking Head” Video In 60 Seconds
records.description: Simply put, Humanify is an AI-powered video creation platform that transforms any text, keyword, URL, or document into engaging and realistic “virtual human” videos automatically. These videos feature lifelike digital avatars delivering your message like human

records.name: NotionClinic Templates
records.tagline: Operational Notion Zen for Busy Clinicians
records.description: Professional Notion templates that transform chaotic small healthcare practice workflows into simple, streamlined, HIPAA-compliant systems. Focus on patient care, not paperwork.

records.name: Launchified
records.tagline: Launching Simplified.
records.description: Hey ProductHunt! After watching 3 side projects die in silence, I realized coding was the easy part. Launchified automates the entire launch process so you can focus on building. No marketing expertise needed—just ship and get noticed.

records.name: Vibe Life Coach
records.tagline: Transform your future w/ AI-powered coaching - 100% private
records.description: A private AI life coach that lives on your device—no cloud, no data mining. Track habits, moods & goals. Catch negative patterns in real time. Get weekly insights. 100% local, 0% surveillance. Growth without giving up your privacy.

records.name: HavTalk
records.tagline: It’s like fanfiction, but your characters talk back.
records.description: Experience immersive AI roleplay with legendary characters. Create unique personas, engage in dynamic conversations, and shape your own interactive stories with our advanced AI platform.

records.name: Coin Value Checker
records.tagline: Identify coins by photo & instantly get accurate prices
records.description: Instantly identify coin’s type, year, and other details from photos. Get a real-time market value estimate based on recent eBay and auction sales — no coin expertise required.

records.name: PDF to Excel Extractor
records.tagline: PDF to Excel converter app on Android. Need Testers
records.description: I just launched a PDF to Excel converter app on Android and would love your feedback. 👉 Install via Play Store https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yourname.pdftoexcel Thanks in advance to anyone who gives it a try!

records.name: Relevant Charts
records.tagline: Can You Be Number 1?
records.description: Relevant Charts is a social app that ranks photos worldwide to see who has the best picture. It ranks posts across categories such as Fashion, Sports, Food, Music & 100 more. Users can compete in any city, state, or country. More likes equal a higher ranking.

records.name: Wagoo
records.tagline: Private desktop assistant-reduce friction & run local
records.description: Wagoo is your private, invisible AI desktop assistant. Get intelligent help anywhere with automatic screen context detection, voice transcription, and offline private AI capabilities. Instantly answer queries with latest models. Use local LLMs for privacy.

records.name: Memolect
records.tagline: AI meeting notetaker that updates your Jira
records.description: Memolect is your AI notetaker for dev teams - joins virtual meetings, transcribes, and suggests Jira, Linear & Confluence updates you can execute with a single click. Includes AI summaries and ChatGPT-style search to recall decisions instantly.

records.name: Free Text Convert

records.description: Convert text case instantly - UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase. Free online text tools with no signup required.

records.name: what color make

records.description: Create stunning color combinations with our advanced color mixing tool. Perfect for designers, artists, and developers who need precise color control and instant HEX codes.

records.name: Product Hunt – Feed-mode
records.tagline: Consume Product Hunt as if it were a feed
records.description: This is the Feed version of Product Hunt. It's a prototype. Code is open 🎨 I built a media scrubber that let's you view all the images/videos of a launch in just a few seconds. ❗ You can't upvote yet. (I need write permissions?)

records.name: White Screen Tool
